name: [Shoptet CLI Greenfield] Phase 1 — Offline Foundation
description:
Part of the "Shoptet Partner CLI — Greenfield Rebuild" initiative (label: shoptet-cli-greenfield).

Scaffold + static checks, no platform dependency, no auth, no network beyond npm. Useful on its own but not yet the full MVP — partners have no dev loop until Phase 2.

Scope per cli-greenfield.md §13 Phase 1:

- Shared lint packages (@shoptet/stylelint-config, @shoptet/eslint-config) + @shoptet/datalayer knowledge pack (§8)
- shoptet init — scaffold, editor-agnostic configs, committed shoptet.config.json/shoptet.lock, gitignored .shoptet/ (§5.7, §10)
- shoptet validate — severity policy (deterministic=error, snapshot-derived=warning) (§8)
- shoptet refresh + shoptet update / config autoupdate — knowledge bundle refresh and CLI self-update (§9)
- shoptet doctor — environment sanity, target-shop reporting, resolved-config provenance (§9)
